failure_type: wind / gusts + late detection (short sensing range) + sensor noise + UAV too fast to react
explanation: The UAV collided with an obstacle at 5.5 seconds due to a combination of environmental and operational factors. The 1.5 m/s headwind, sensor noise, and high cruise speed of 8.1 m/s prevented the UAV from reacting in time after detecting the obstacle only 1.0 second before the closest approach. Counterfactual analysis confirms that removing the wind, noise, or reducing speed would have prevented the failure.
